criteria.story: Each clue is a short story with a surprising or human detail, not a dry chronicle line.
criteria.source: Each clue has an HTTP(S) source URL supporting its specific claim. A plausible URL alone is not evidence.
criteria.wayIn: At least one clue gives a typical daily-puzzle player a recognizable way in.
criteria.noLeakage: No clue gives the year away through numerals, spelled years, era words or anachronisms.
criteria.difficulty: Assess the whole puzzle, in reveal order, against the mode target. Predictions are editorial estimates, not measured solve rates.

order.metric: starters placing no more than one card wrong
